owner_question: Stocks like NVIDIA rose steadily for years. Can we find stocks that are 'constantly on the rise' with math, buy them, and hold with little turnover?
what_is_already_known: Step 189: 12-1 momentum, 6-month momentum and 52-week-high proximity all had negative 13-week decile spreads on this panel. Step 257: trend consistency closed, 2020-2026 evaluation. Step 303: long horizons tested only on fundamental signals. What has never been tested is the owner's actual design: price persistence judged over a ONE-YEAR hold with ANNUAL rebalancing, which is low turnover by construction.

data.prices: data/clean_full_history_prices_v1/weekly_adjusted_prices_clean.csv.gz (weekly, 2011-01-07 onward, ~2,760 issuers, Yahoo-based; delisted issuers largely missing)

universe_per_decision: close >= $5; 53 complete weekly closes ending at the decision; median daily dollar volume over the prior 63 trading days >= $5M

signals.S1_momentum_12_1: price 4 weeks ago / price 52 weeks ago - 1 (the standard skip-a-month momentum)
signals.S2_steady_riser: OLS of ln(price) on time over the last 52 weekly closes; score = annualised slope x R-squared. High only when a stock rose AND rose smoothly -- the literal 'constantly on the rise'.
signals.declared_sign: POSITIVE for both. A negative result is reported, never inverted.

screen.decisions: every 13 weeks from the first week with a full year of history
screen.target: 52-week forward return from the first weekly close after the decision
screen.measures: rank IC, top-minus-bottom decile spread, decile monotonicity; block bootstrap with block 4 (52-week horizon / 13-week spacing); independent windows = decisions / 4

book.rule: top 20 by the signal, equal weight, bought at the first close after the decision and held 52 weeks untouched; one rebalance a year. Names that stop trading go to cash.
controls: equal weight of the same liquid universe, same annual rebalance
200 random 20-name books from the same universe, same dates
book.robustness: largest single-name contributor removed; same-risk alpha vs SPY (CAPM) and FF5+momentum alpha

pass_requires_all: book beats the equal-weight universe AND the random-book 95th percentile at 50 bps
book beats the universe in at least 3 of 4 regimes
result survives removing its largest contributor
